authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10648 raśmi gives Punjabi rassī/rassā rope, a family transmitted into several Indo-Aryan languages, and Western Pahari rośśo rope. The survey rasso/rośi shapes match these regional variants; the precise intra-Indo-Aryan borrowing route remains open. Exact survey form rasːo is preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4386 *grilla explicitly gives Punjabi gillā and Hindi gillā wet. The geminate-l forms directly match this family; Turner calls its derivation from *gṛdla very doubtful, a qualification retained here. Exact survey form gilːā is preserved.
